info.name: GLOBO API
info.description: GLOBO food delivery API. Run the folders in order against a fresh server (npm start). baseUrl is http://localhost:3000/api (REST resources); serverUrl is http://localhost:3000 (health, login, checkout, menu and error checks). Requests save ids and the login token in collection variables.

exec: pm.test("Only Centro pizzas", () => pm.response.json().forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.area).to.eql("Centro"); pm.expect(r.type).to.eql("pizza"); }));
pm.test("Only area changed", () => { pm.expect(r.area).to.eql("Retiro"); pm.expect(r.name).to.eql("Telepizza Puerta del Sol"); });
pm.test("Filters applied", () => pm.response.json().forEach(d => { pm.expect(d.brand).to.eql("telepizza"); pm.expect(d.category).to.eql("main"); pm.expect(d.price).to.be.within(8, 10); }));
pm.test("Panna Cotta on the menu", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(d => d.name)).to.include("Panna Cotta"));
pm.test("Gets a token and a discount code", () => { pm.expect(u.token).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(u.discountCode).to.match(/^GLOBO-/); });

exec: pm.test("Replaced", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.include({"name":"Eva","email":"eva@example.com","brand":"telepizza","type":"delivery","date":"2026-11-02","message":"The order arrived one hour late.","status":"in progress"}));

pm.test("Only that field changed", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.include({"name":"Eva","email":"eva@example.com","brand":"telepizza","type":"delivery","date":"2026-11-02","message":"The order arrived one hour late.","status":"resolved"}));
